scripts.network:allow: sudo setcap cap_sys_ptrace,cap_sys_admin+ep /usr/bin/nsenter && sudo setcap cap_net_admin+ep /usr/sbin/tc && sudo /usr/sbin/getcap /usr/bin/nsenter /usr/sbin/tc
scripts.dev: bash ./scripts/kill-dev.sh && pnpm run init && pnpm run docker:dev:up && pnpm run network:allow && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:nosudo: bash ./scripts/kill-dev.sh && bash ./scripts/docker-network.sh && pnpm run docker:dev:up && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:stop: pnpm run docker:dev:down && pnpm run network:deny
scripts.dev:remove: docker compose -f docker/openworkspace_dev/docker-compose.yml down -v && pnpm run clean && pnpm run network:deny && echo '✅ 已移除開發環境 volumes 和 network'
scripts.docker:up: pnpm run init && pnpm run build:template-images && docker compose -f docker/openworkspace/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.docker:remove: docker compose -f docker/openworkspace/docker-compose.yml down -v && pnpm run clean && echo '✅ 已移除正式環境 volumes 和 network'
